about: Modwerk source-only chromatic-aftertouch-fix package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/chromatic-aftertouch-fix.

mods.title: Pad Pressure Fix
mods.summary: A held pad's pressure reaches the sound's aftertouch and MIDI out during a retrig roll too, and CHROMATIC pads send their aftertouch on the note they played.
mods.description: A held pad's pressure reaches the sound's aftertouch and MIDI out during a retrig roll too, and CHROMATIC pads send their aftertouch on the note they played.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: This source ran on the author's Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 in a 16-module combined image (PP01, as reported, USB MIDI logged); this package has not run alone on a unit.
